name: Miyamura Hiroshi
source:
Hiroshi is an art teacher at [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]Takuya[/url]'s high school. He's a nice guy and gets along very well with all the students. Therefore, it's not surprising that he's very sympathetic to Takuya's new [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]awkward situation[/url], and he will do everything that's necessary in order to make Takuya comfortable in his new skin.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582010-x-change/faqs/22272]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
